title: AFKSwitch state, version 2
description: ~/.afkswitch/state.json. Written only through the state protocol in spec/presence.md. Version 1 files (state.v1.schema.json) are read and migrated.

since.description: When this status began. Informative only: ordering uses generation, never clocks.

context.description: Opaque /afk context, verbatim; max 2048 Unicode scalar values. LF/tab allowed; other C0, DEL, C1, ESC, CRLF and lone surrogates rejected. /back event context is not stored.

generation.description: Strictly increases by one on every durable transition; unchanged by an idempotent repeat.
